dataset_info.summary: Clips of “hey jarvis” generated by many different synthetic voices, used as the audio a detector must wake on; the clips it must ignore are pooled from a shared not-wake-word collection of speech, public-domain sounds, environmental audio, music and ambient noise. One row is one clip with its label. Synthesis covers many voices cheaply, but the clips carry no room acoustics and no microphone variation, so this board does not exercise either.
dataset_info.notes: Synthetic 'hey jarvis' positives (TTS across many voices). Negatives pooled across the not-wake-word collection — general speech, public-domain sounds, environmental audio (ESC-50), music (FMA) and ambient noise — so false-accept rate reflects many scenarios. openWakeWord and microWakeWord both ship a 'hey jarvis' model, so this is a head-to-head neural comparison.
